package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"crypto/sha512"
	"debug/pe"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

const (
	responsePrefix = "RFS-FIXTURE/1 "
	controlLimit   = 1024
	streamLimit    = 16 << 20
	qemuSHA512     = "51db3e9f8afe9e3046ecab114d5c4718f6f8844e956dd1cb60591a903eb99b74feaf7cf7eb295cc2faacc0b2befd19a646a58a86db980be4dbf1b4a7d9d8d6a7"
	qemuURL        = "https://qemu.weilnetz.de/aarch64/qemu-arm-setup-20260811.exe"
)

var (
	errOwnedCleanup = errors.New("owned process cleanup was not confirmed")
	hex40           = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9a-f]{40}$`)
	hex64           = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9a-f]{64}$`)
	runIDPattern    = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,96}$`)
	newPlatform     = func() (platform, error) { return nil, errors.New("controller requires native Windows ARM64") }
)

type artifact struct {
	Path   string `json:"path"`
	SHA256 string `json:"sha256"`
	Size   int64  `json:"size"`
}

type manifest struct {
	Format        int               `json:"format"`
	SourceSHA     string            `json:"source_sha"`
	SourceTreeSHA string            `json:"source_tree_sha"`
	SourceDirty   *bool             `json:"source_dirty"`
	SourceFiles   map[string]string `json:"source_files"`
	Volume        string            `json:"volume"`
	BootToken     string            `json:"boot_token"`
	QuotaBytes    int64             `json:"quota_bytes"`
	DiskBytes     int64             `json:"disk_bytes"`
	Build         struct {
		GoVersion    string            `json:"go_version"`
		GOOS         string            `json:"goos"`
		GOARCH       string            `json:"goarch"`
		CGOEnabled   string            `json:"cgo_enabled"`
		Flags        []string          `json:"flags,omitempty"`
		ToolVersions map[string]string `json:"tool_versions,omitempty"`
	} `json:"build"`
	QEMU struct {
		Version string `json:"version"`
		URL     string `json:"url"`
		SHA512  string `json:"sha512"`
		Machine string `json:"machine"`
	} `json:"qemu"`
	Artifacts map[string]artifact `json:"artifacts"`
}

type packageManifest struct {
	Format          int               `json:"format"`
	ArchiveSHA512   string            `json:"archive_sha512"`
	Executable      string            `json:"executable"`
	DataDir         string            `json:"data_dir"`
	SevenZipVersion string            `json:"seven_zip_version"`
	Files           map[string]string `json:"files"`
}

type identity struct {
	RunID     string `json:"run_id"`
	SourceSHA string `json:"source_sha"`
	Nonce     string `json:"fixture_nonce"`
}

type response struct {
	identity
	Phase          string `json:"phase"`
	Sequence       uint64 `json:"sequence"`
	Op             string `json:"op"`
	Status         string `json:"status"`
	Category       string `json:"category,omitempty"`
	Cause          string `json:"cause,omitempty"`
	ExitCode       *int   `json:"exit_code,omitempty"`
	AuthorityEpoch string `json:"authority_epoch,omitempty"`
	ObjectID       string `json:"object_id,omitempty"`
}

type child interface {
	Input() io.WriteCloser
	Output() io.ReadCloser
	Errors() io.ReadCloser
	Done() <-chan struct{}
	Result() error
	PID() uint32
	VerifyControlPeer(context.Context, net.Conn) (map[string]any, error)
	// Finish verifies the job is empty. Force termination is never a graceful result.
	Finish() (forced bool, err error)
	FinishBefore(time.Time) (forced bool, err error)
}

type platform interface {
	Preflight() (map[string]any, error)
	ListenControl(context.Context) (net.Listener, error)
	Start(executable string, args []string, directory string) (child, error)
}

type options struct {
	Repo, ArtifactDir, PackageDir, SourceSHA, SourceTreeSHA, RunID string
	RequireNative                                                  bool
}

func rejectDuplicateKeys(data []byte) error {
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
	var value func() error
	value = func() error {
		token, err := decoder.Token()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		delimiter, nested := token.(json.Delim)
		if !nested {
			return nil
		}
		if delimiter != '{' && delimiter != '[' {
			return errors.New("unexpected JSON delimiter")
		}
		keys := make(map[string]bool)
		for decoder.More() {
			if delimiter == '{' {
				keyToken, err := decoder.Token()
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				key, ok := keyToken.(string)
				if !ok || keys[key] {
					return errors.New("duplicate or invalid JSON field")
				}
				keys[key] = true
			}
			if err := value(); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		_, err = decoder.Token()
		return err
	}
	return value()
}

func decodeOne(data []byte, target any) error {
	if err := rejectDuplicateKeys(data); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var extra any
	if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); err != io.EOF {
		return errors.New("expected exactly one JSON value")
	}
	return nil
}

func readJSON(path string, target any) error {
	file, err := os.Open(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer file.Close()
	data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, streamLimit+1))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if len(data) > streamLimit {
		return fmt.Errorf("manifest %s exceeds size limit", path)
	}
	return decodeOne(data, target)
}

func makeOwnedDirectories(root, relative string) error {
	current := root
	for _, name := range strings.Split(relative, "/") {
		if name == "" || name == "." || name == ".." {
			return errors.New("invalid owned directory path")
		}
		current = filepath.Join(current, name)
		info, err := os.Lstat(current)
		if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
			if err := os.Mkdir(current, 0700); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			info, err = os.Lstat(current)
		}
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if !info.IsDir() || info.Mode()&(os.ModeSymlink|os.ModeIrregular) != 0 {
			return fmt.Errorf("owned directory is not a regular directory: %s", current)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func safePath(root, relative string) (string, error) {
	if relative == "" || strings.Contains(relative, `\`) || strings.Contains(relative, ":") || filepath.IsAbs(relative) {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("invalid relative artifact path %q", relative)
	}
	for _, part := range strings.Split(relative, "/") {
		if part == "" || part == "." || part == ".." {
			return "", fmt.Errorf("invalid artifact path %q", relative)
		}
	}
	current := root
	for _, part := range strings.Split(relative, "/") {
		current = filepath.Join(current, part)
		info, err := os.Lstat(current)
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || info.Mode()&os.ModeIrregular != 0 {
			return "", fmt.Errorf("artifact path is not regular: %s", current)
		}
	}
	return current, nil
}

func privateOutput(path string) (*os.File, error) {
	if err := validatePrivateDirectory(filepath.Dir(path)); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	file, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY, 0600)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := makePrivateFile(path); err != nil {
		return nil, errors.Join(err, file.Close(), os.Remove(path))
	}
	return file, nil
}

func fileHash(path string) (string, int64, error) {
	file, err := os.Open(path)
	if err != nil {
		return "", 0, err
	}
	defer file.Close()
	info, err := file.Stat()
	if err != nil {
		return "", 0, err
	}
	if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
		return "", 0, fmt.Errorf("expected regular file: %s", path)
	}
	hash := sha256.New()
	size, err := io.Copy(hash, file)
	if err != nil {
		return "", 0, err
	}
	return hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)), size, nil
}

func verifyFiles(root string, files map[string]string) error {
	if len(files) == 0 {
		return errors.New("empty source or package file manifest")
	}
	paths := make([]string, 0, len(files))
	for path := range files {
		paths = append(paths, path)
	}
	sort.Strings(paths)
	for _, path := range paths {
		if !hex64.MatchString(files[path]) {
			return fmt.Errorf("invalid hash for %s", path)
		}
		full, err := safePath(root, path)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		actual, _, err := fileHash(full)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if actual != files[path] {
			return fmt.Errorf("SHA256 mismatch: %s", path)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func validateManifest(m manifest, o options) error {
	if m.Format != 1 || !hex40.MatchString(m.SourceSHA) || !hex40.MatchString(m.SourceTreeSHA) || (m.SourceDirty == nil || *m.SourceDirty) || m.SourceSHA != o.SourceSHA || m.SourceTreeSHA != o.SourceTreeSHA {
		return errors.New("artifact requires the same clean checkout and tree SHA")
	}
	if m.Volume != "fixture-current" || !hex64.MatchString(m.BootToken) || m.QuotaBytes != 64<<20 || m.DiskBytes != 1<<30 {
		return errors.New("artifact volume, boot token, quota, or disk size differs from fixed fixture")
	}
	if m.Build.GoVersion != "go1.26.8" || m.Build.GOOS != "linux" || m.Build.GOARCH != "amd64" || m.Build.CGOEnabled != "0" {
		return errors.New("authority build provenance differs from pinned build")
	}
	if len(m.Build.Flags) > 64 || len(m.Build.ToolVersions) > 64 {
		return errors.New("build provenance exceeds field limit")
	}
	for _, value := range m.Build.Flags {
		if len(value) > 4096 {
			return errors.New("build flag exceeds size limit")
		}
	}
	for key, value := range m.Build.ToolVersions {
		if len(key) > 128 || len(value) > 4096 {
			return errors.New("build tool version exceeds size limit")
		}
	}

	if m.QEMU.Version != "11.1.0" || m.QEMU.URL != qemuURL || m.QEMU.SHA512 != qemuSHA512 || m.QEMU.Machine != "pc-q35-11.1" {
		return errors.New("QEMU provenance differs from pinned bundle")
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"kernel", "initramfs", "data", "probe_windows_arm64", "controller_windows_arm64"} {
		value, ok := m.Artifacts[name]
		if !ok || !hex64.MatchString(value.SHA256) || value.Size <= 0 {
			return fmt.Errorf("missing or invalid %s artifact", name)
		}
	}
	if m.Artifacts["data"].Size != m.DiskBytes {
		return errors.New("pristine disk size differs from fixed disk size")
	}
	if err := verifyFiles(o.Repo, m.SourceFiles); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("source inputs: %w", err)
	}
	for name, value := range m.Artifacts {
		path, err := safePath(o.ArtifactDir, value.Path)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		actual, size, err := fileHash(path)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if actual != value.SHA256 || size != value.Size {
			return fmt.Errorf("artifact hash or size mismatch: %s", name)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

type cappedWriter struct {
	mu        sync.Mutex
	writer    io.Writer
	remaining int64
}

func (w *cappedWriter) Write(data []byte) (int, error) {
	w.mu.Lock()
	defer w.mu.Unlock()
	if int64(len(data)) > w.remaining {
		n, err := w.writer.Write(data[:w.remaining])
		w.remaining = 0
		_, markerErr := io.WriteString(w.writer, "\n[fixture log limit exceeded; stream truncated]\n")
		return n, errors.Join(errors.New("fixture stream exceeds 16 MiB"), err, markerErr)
	}
	n, err := w.writer.Write(data)
	w.remaining -= int64(n)
	return n, err
}

type events struct {
	identity
	output   *cappedWriter
	sequence uint64
}

func (e *events) record(phase, category string, details any) error {
	e.sequence++
	record := struct {
		identity
		Sequence  uint64 `json:"sequence"`
		Subsystem string `json:"subsystem"`
		Time      string `json:"time"`
		Phase     string `json:"phase"`
		Category  string `json:"category"`
		Details   any    `json:"details"`
	}{e.identity, e.sequence, "windows-controller", time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano), phase, category, details}
	data, err := json.Marshal(record)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = e.output.Write(append(data, '\n'))
	return err
}

func parseResponse(line []byte, expected identity) (*response, error) {
	if !bytes.HasPrefix(line, []byte(responsePrefix)) {
		return nil, nil
	}
	if len(line)+1 > controlLimit {
		return nil, errors.New("guest control response exceeds 1 KiB")
	}
	var value response
	if err := decodeOne(bytes.TrimPrefix(line, []byte(responsePrefix)), &value); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("guest response JSON: %w", err)
	}
	if value.identity != expected {
		return nil, errors.New("guest response belongs to another run, source, or nonce")
	}
	if value.Status != "ok" && value.Status != "error" {
		return nil, errors.New("guest response has invalid status")
	}
	if value.Status == "error" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("guest %s/%s: %s", value.Phase, value.Category, value.Cause)
	}
	return &value, nil
}

func commandBytes(nonce string, sequence uint64, command string) ([]byte, error) {
	if !hex64.MatchString(nonce) || sequence == 0 || (command != "start" && command != "stop-authority" && command != "shutdown") {
		return nil, errors.New("invalid guest command")
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(struct {
		Nonce    string `json:"nonce"`
		Sequence uint64 `json:"sequence"`
		Command  string `json:"command"`
	}{nonce, sequence, command})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	data = append(data, '\n')
	if len(data) > controlLimit {
		return nil, errors.New("guest command exceeds 1 KiB")
	}
	return data, nil
}

type ownedReader struct {
	name string
	done chan struct{}
	err  error
}

func startReader(name string, read func() error, report func(error)) *ownedReader {
	r := &ownedReader{name: name, done: make(chan struct{})}
	go func() {
		r.err = read()
		if r.err != nil && report != nil {
			report(r.err)
		}
		close(r.done)
	}()
	return r
}

func joinReaders(ctx context.Context, readers []*ownedReader) error {
	var result error
	for _, reader := range readers {
		select {
		case <-reader.done:
		default:
			select {
			case <-reader.done:
			case <-ctx.Done():
				result = errors.Join(result, fmt.Errorf("join %s: %w", reader.name, ctx.Err()))
				continue
			}
		}
		if reader.err != nil {
			result = errors.Join(result, fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", reader.name, reader.err))
		}
	}
	return result
}

type guestChannel struct {
	child child
	identity
	conn       net.Conn
	responses  chan response
	fault      chan error
	readers    []*ownedReader
	serial     *ownedReader
	logs       map[string]*os.File
	logsClosed bool
	logsErr    error
}

func newGuestChannel(id identity, directory string) (*guestChannel, error) {
	g := &guestChannel{identity: id, responses: make(chan response, 1), fault: make(chan error, 1), logs: make(map[string]*os.File)}
	for _, name := range []string{"qemu-stdout", "qemu-stderr", "guest-serial", "authority-stdout", "authority-stderr"} {
		file, err := privateOutput(filepath.Join(directory, name+".log"))
		if err != nil {
			return nil, errors.Join(err, g.closeLogs())
		}
		g.logs[name] = file
	}
	return g, nil
}

func (g *guestChannel) report(err error) {
	select {
	case g.fault <- err:
	default:
	}
}

func (g *guestChannel) closeLogs() error {
	if !g.logsClosed {
		g.logsClosed = true
		for _, name := range []string{"qemu-stdout", "qemu-stderr", "guest-serial", "authority-stdout", "authority-stderr"} {
			if file, exists := g.logs[name]; exists {
				g.logsErr = errors.Join(g.logsErr, file.Close())
			}
		}
	}
	return g.logsErr
}

func (g *guestChannel) startDiagnostics(process child) {
	g.child = process
	for _, stream := range []struct {
		name  string
		input io.Reader
	}{{"qemu-stdout", process.Output()}, {"qemu-stderr", process.Errors()}} {
		g.readers = append(g.readers, startReader(stream.name, func() error {
			_, err := io.Copy(&cappedWriter{writer: g.logs[stream.name], remaining: streamLimit}, stream.input)
			return err
		}, g.report))
	}
}

func serialLine(data []byte, atEOF bool) (int, []byte, error) {
	if end := bytes.IndexByte(data, '\n'); end >= 0 {
		return end + 1, data[:end], nil
	}
	if atEOF && len(data) != 0 {
		return 0, nil, io.ErrUnexpectedEOF
	}
	return 0, nil, nil
}

func (g *guestChannel) startSerial(conn net.Conn) {
	g.conn = conn
	g.serial = startReader("guest serial", func() error {
		serial := &cappedWriter{writer: g.logs["guest-serial"], remaining: streamLimit}
		logs := map[string]*cappedWriter{
			"stdout": {writer: g.logs["authority-stdout"], remaining: streamLimit},
			"stderr": {writer: g.logs["authority-stderr"], remaining: streamLimit},
		}
		scanner := bufio.NewScanner(conn)
		scanner.Buffer(make([]byte, 4096), streamLimit)
		scanner.Split(serialLine)
		for scanner.Scan() {
			line := bytes.TrimSuffix(scanner.Bytes(), []byte{'\r'})
			handled, err := authorityLogLine(line, logs)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if handled {
				continue
			}
			if _, err := serial.Write(append(bytes.Clone(line), '\n')); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			message, err := parseResponse(line, g.identity)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if message != nil {
				select {
				case g.responses <- *message:
				default:
					return errors.New("guest produced an unsolicited or duplicate response")
				}
			}
		}
		return scanner.Err()
	}, g.report)
	g.readers = append(g.readers, g.serial)
}

type controlSocket struct {
	listener     net.Listener
	done         chan struct{}
	listenerOnce sync.Once
	listenerErr  error
	mu           sync.Mutex
	conn         net.Conn
	acceptErr    error
	closing      bool
	connClosed   bool
	connErr      error
}

func newControlSocket(listener net.Listener) *controlSocket {
	s := &controlSocket{listener: listener, done: make(chan struct{})}
	go func() {
		conn, err := listener.Accept()
		err = errors.Join(err, s.closeListener())
		s.mu.Lock()
		s.conn, s.acceptErr = conn, err
		if s.closing {
			s.closeConnLocked()
		}
		s.mu.Unlock()
		close(s.done)
	}()
	return s
}

func (s *controlSocket) closeListener() error {
	s.listenerOnce.Do(func() { s.listenerErr = s.listener.Close() })
	return s.listenerErr
}

func (s *controlSocket) closeConnLocked() {
	if s.conn != nil && !s.connClosed {
		s.connClosed = true
		s.connErr = s.conn.Close()
	}
}

func (s *controlSocket) closeIO() error {
	err := s.closeListener()
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	s.closing = true
	s.closeConnLocked()
	return errors.Join(err, s.connErr)
}

func controlPort(address net.Addr) (int, error) {
	tcp, ok := address.(*net.TCPAddr)
	if !ok || tcp == nil || tcp.IP.To4() == nil || !tcp.IP.Equal(net.IPv4(127, 0, 0, 1)) || tcp.Zone != "" || tcp.Port < 1 || tcp.Port > 65535 {
		return 0, errors.New("control endpoint must be concrete IPv4 127.0.0.1 with a nonzero port")
	}
	return tcp.Port, nil
}

func (s *controlSocket) accept(ctx context.Context, process child, fault <-chan error) (net.Conn, map[string]any, error) {
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	select {
	case <-s.done:
	case <-process.Done():
		return nil, nil, errors.Join(errors.New("QEMU exited before control accept"), process.Result())
	case err := <-fault:
		return nil, nil, err
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return nil, nil, ctx.Err()
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	conn, err := s.conn, s.acceptErr
	s.mu.Unlock()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("accept control: %w", err)
	}
	if conn == nil {
		return nil, nil, errors.New("control accept returned no connection")
	}
	local, err := controlPort(conn.LocalAddr())
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	bound, err := controlPort(s.listener.Addr())
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	if local != bound {
		return nil, nil, errors.New("accepted control endpoint differs from owned listener")
	}
	if _, err := controlPort(conn.RemoteAddr()); err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	facts, err := process.VerifyControlPeer(ctx, conn)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("control peer ownership: %w", err)
	}
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	if facts == nil {
		return nil, nil, errors.New("control peer ownership evidence is absent")
	}
	return conn, facts, nil
}

func (s *controlSocket) join(ctx context.Context) error {
	select {
	case <-s.done:
	default:
		select {
		case <-s.done:
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return fmt.Errorf("join control accept: %w", ctx.Err())
		}
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	return errors.Join(s.acceptErr, s.connErr)
}

func finishGuest(process child, control *controlSocket, guest *guestChannel, deadline time.Time) (bool, error) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithDeadline(context.Background(), deadline)
	defer cancel()
	var result error
	if control != nil {
		result = errors.Join(result, control.closeIO())
	}
	forced := false
	if process != nil {
		var err error
		forced, err = process.FinishBefore(deadline)
		if err != nil {
			result = errors.Join(result, fmt.Errorf("%w: %w", errOwnedCleanup, err))
		}
		if forced {
			result = errors.Join(result, errors.New("QEMU required forced termination; graceful shutdown unconfirmed"))
		}
	}
	if control != nil {
		result = errors.Join(result, control.join(ctx))
	}
	if guest != nil {
		result = errors.Join(result, joinReaders(ctx, guest.readers), guest.closeLogs())
	}
	return forced, errors.Join(result, ctx.Err())
}

func authorityLogLine(line []byte, logs map[string]*cappedWriter) (bool, error) {
	for name, writer := range logs {
		prefix := []byte("RFS-AUTHORITY/" + name + " ")
		if !bytes.HasPrefix(line, prefix) {
			continue
		}
		data, err := base64.StdEncoding.Strict().DecodeString(string(bytes.TrimPrefix(line, prefix)))
		if err != nil {
			return true, fmt.Errorf("authority %s log frame: %w", name, err)
		}
		_, err = writer.Write(data)
		return true, err
	}
	if bytes.HasPrefix(line, []byte("RFS-AUTHORITY/")) {
		return true, errors.New("unknown authority log frame")
	}
	return false, nil
}

func checkedAcknowledgement(value response, sequence uint64, op, phase string) (response, error) {
	if value.Sequence != sequence || value.Op != op || value.Phase != phase {
		return response{}, fmt.Errorf("unexpected guest response %s/%s sequence %d", value.Phase, value.Op, value.Sequence)
	}
	if (op == "stop-authority" || op == "shutdown") && (value.ExitCode == nil || *value.ExitCode != 0) {
		return response{}, errors.New("guest did not confirm successful authority exit")
	}
	return value, nil
}

func (g *guestChannel) receive(ctx context.Context, sequence uint64, op, phase string) (response, error) {
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return response{}, err
	}
	select {
	case err := <-g.fault:
		return response{}, err
	default:
	}
	exited := g.child.Done()
	var serialDone <-chan struct{}
	if g.serial != nil {
		serialDone = g.serial.done
	}
	for {
		select {
		case value := <-g.responses:
			return checkedAcknowledgement(value, sequence, op, phase)
		case err := <-g.fault:
			return response{}, err
		case <-serialDone:
			select {
			case value := <-g.responses:
				return checkedAcknowledgement(value, sequence, op, phase)
			default:
				return response{}, errors.Join(errors.New("guest serial ended before acknowledgement"), io.ErrUnexpectedEOF, g.serial.err)
			}
		case <-exited:
			if op != "shutdown" {
				return response{}, errors.Join(errors.New("QEMU exited before "+op+" acknowledgement"), g.child.Result())
			}
			exited = nil
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return response{}, ctx.Err()
		}
	}
}

func (g *guestChannel) command(ctx context.Context, sequence uint64, op string) (response, error) {
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return response{}, err
	}
	select {
	case value := <-g.responses:
		return response{}, fmt.Errorf("unsolicited guest response before command: %s", value.Op)
	case err := <-g.fault:
		return response{}, err
	default:
	}
	data, err := commandBytes(g.Nonce, sequence, op)
	if err != nil {
		return response{}, err
	}
	deadline, bounded := ctx.Deadline()
	if !bounded || g.conn == nil {
		return response{}, errors.New("guest command requires an authenticated socket and deadline")
	}
	if err := g.conn.SetWriteDeadline(deadline); err != nil {
		return response{}, err
	}
	interrupted := make(chan struct{})
	var interruptErr error
	stop := context.AfterFunc(ctx, func() {
		interruptErr = g.conn.SetWriteDeadline(time.Now())
		close(interrupted)
	})
	n, writeErr := g.conn.Write(data)
	if writeErr == nil && n != len(data) {
		writeErr = io.ErrShortWrite
	}
	if writeErr != nil && !time.Now().Before(deadline) {
		writeErr = errors.Join(writeErr, context.DeadlineExceeded)
	}
	if !stop() {
		<-interrupted
		writeErr = errors.Join(writeErr, interruptErr)
	}
	writeErr = errors.Join(writeErr, ctx.Err(), g.conn.SetWriteDeadline(time.Time{}))
	if writeErr != nil {
		return response{}, writeErr
	}
	return g.receive(ctx, sequence, op, op)
}

func qemuArguments(m manifest, id identity, kernel, initramfs, data, bios string, port, controlPort int) []string {
	escape := func(value string) string { return strings.ReplaceAll(value, ",", ",,") }
	appendArgs := "console=ttyS0,115200 rdinit=/init panic=1 net.ifnames=0" +
		" RFS_FIXTURE_BOOT_TOKEN=" + m.BootToken + " RFS_FIXTURE_NONCE=" + id.Nonce +
		" RFS_FIXTURE_RUN_ID=" + id.RunID + " RFS_FIXTURE_VOLUME=" + m.Volume
	return []string{
		"-L", bios, "-machine", m.QEMU.Machine, "-accel", "tcg,thread=multi", "-cpu", "qemu64", "-smp", "2", "-m", "1024",
		"-nodefaults", "-no-user-config", "-display", "none", "-monitor", "none", "-no-reboot",
		"-kernel", kernel, "-initrd", initramfs, "-append", appendArgs,
		"-chardev", "socket,id=console,host=127.0.0.1,port=" + strconv.Itoa(controlPort) + ",server=off,reconnect-ms=0", "-serial", "chardev:console",
		"-drive", "file=" + escape(data) + ",format=raw,if=none,id=data,cache=writeback,rerror=report,werror=report",
		"-device", "virtio-blk-pci,drive=data",
		"-netdev", "user,id=net,ipv6=off,restrict=on,hostfwd=tcp:127.0.0.1:" + strconv.Itoa(port) + "-10.0.2.15:8080",
		"-device", "virtio-net-pci,netdev=net", "-object", "rng-builtin,id=rng", "-device", "virtio-rng-pci,rng=rng", "-rtc", "base=utc,clock=host",
	}
}

func runTool(ctx context.Context, host platform, executable string, args []string, directory, name string) (output []byte, resultErr error) {
	stdout, err := privateOutput(filepath.Join(directory, name+"-stdout.log"))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	stderr, err := privateOutput(filepath.Join(directory, name+"-stderr.log"))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, errors.Join(err, stdout.Close())
	}
	var process child
	var readers []*ownedReader
	defer func() {
		deadline := time.Now().Add(10 * time.Second)
		cleanup, cancel := context.WithDeadline(context.Background(), deadline)
		defer cancel()
		if process != nil {
			forced, err := process.FinishBefore(deadline)
			if err != nil {
				resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, fmt.Errorf("%w: %w", errOwnedCleanup, err))
			}
			if forced {
				resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, errors.New("owned job required forced termination"))
			}
		}
		resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, joinReaders(cleanup, readers), stdout.Close(), stderr.Close())
	}()
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	process, err = host.Start(executable, args, directory)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var buffer bytes.Buffer
	readers = append(readers, startReader("tool stdout", func() error {
		_, err := io.Copy(&cappedWriter{writer: io.MultiWriter(stdout, &buffer), remaining: streamLimit}, process.Output())
		return err
	}, nil))
	readers = append(readers, startReader("tool stderr", func() error {
		_, err := io.Copy(&cappedWriter{writer: stderr, remaining: streamLimit}, process.Errors())
		return err
	}, nil))
	done, outDone, errDone := process.Done(), (<-chan struct{})(readers[0].done), (<-chan struct{})(readers[1].done)
	for done != nil || outDone != nil || errDone != nil {
		select {
		case <-done:
			done = nil
			if err := process.Result(); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
		case <-outDone:
			outDone = nil
			if readers[0].err != nil {
				return nil, readers[0].err
			}
		case <-errDone:
			errDone = nil
			if readers[1].err != nil {
				return nil, readers[1].err
			}
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return nil, ctx.Err()
		}
	}
	return bytes.Clone(buffer.Bytes()), nil
}

func qemuPreflight(ctx context.Context, host platform, executable, bios, directory string, log *events) error {
	queries := []struct {
		name           string
		args, required []string
	}{
		{"qemu-version", []string{"--version"}, []string{"QEMU emulator version 11.1.0"}},
		{"qemu-machines", []string{"-L", bios, "-machine", "help"}, []string{"pc-q35-11.1"}},
		{"qemu-devices", []string{"-L", bios, "-device", "help"}, []string{"virtio-blk-pci", "virtio-net-pci", "virtio-rng-pci"}},
		{"qemu-objects", []string{"-L", bios, "-object", "help"}, []string{"rng-builtin"}},
		{"qemu-netdevs", []string{"-L", bios, "-netdev", "help"}, []string{"user"}},
		{"qemu-accels", []string{"-L", bios, "-accel", "help"}, []string{"tcg"}},
	}
	for _, query := range queries {
		probeCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 20*time.Second)
		data, err := runTool(probeCtx, host, executable, query.args, directory, query.name)
		cancel()
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", query.name, err)
		}
		for _, required := range query.required {
			if !strings.Contains(string(data), required) {
				return fmt.Errorf("%s lacks %q", query.name, required)
			}
		}
		if err := log.record("preflight", query.name, map[string]any{"verified": query.required}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func validateProbe(data []byte, id identity, phase string, sequence uint64) (response, error) {
	if len(data) > controlLimit {
		return response{}, errors.New("probe receipt exceeds 1 KiB")
	}
	var value response
	if err := decodeOne(data, &value); err != nil {
		return response{}, fmt.Errorf("probe receipt: %w", err)
	}
	if value.identity != id || value.Phase != phase || value.Sequence != sequence || value.Status != "ok" || value.AuthorityEpoch == "" || value.ObjectID == "" {
		return response{}, errors.New("probe did not confirm the expected run, phase, epoch, and object")
	}
	return value, nil
}

func runProbe(ctx context.Context, host platform, guest *guestChannel, executable, directory, endpoint, volume, phase string, sequence uint64) (response, error) {
	probeCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 30*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	args := []string{"--endpoint", endpoint, "--volume", volume, "--run-id", guest.RunID, "--source-sha", guest.SourceSHA,
		"--fixture-nonce", guest.Nonce, "--phase", phase, "--state-file", filepath.Join(directory, "probe-state.json"), "--sequence", strconv.FormatUint(sequence, 10)}
	type result struct {
		data []byte
		err  error
	}
	finished := make(chan result, 1)
	go func() {
		data, err := runTool(probeCtx, host, executable, args, directory, phase)
		finished <- result{data, err}
	}()
	var value result
	select {
	case value = <-finished:
	case err := <-guest.fault:
		cancel()
		value = <-finished
		return response{}, errors.Join(err, value.err)
	case <-guest.child.Done():
		cancel()
		value = <-finished
		return response{}, errors.Join(errors.New("QEMU exited during probe"), guest.child.Result(), value.err)
	case <-probeCtx.Done():
		cancel()
		value = <-finished
		return response{}, errors.Join(probeCtx.Err(), value.err)
	}
	if value.err != nil {
		return response{}, value.err
	}
	return validateProbe(value.data, guest.identity, phase, sequence)
}

func copyDisk(source, destination string, expected artifact) error {
	input, err := os.Open(source)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer input.Close()
	output, err := privateOutput(destination)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	hash := sha256.New()
	n, copyErr := io.Copy(io.MultiWriter(output, hash), input)
	closeErr := errors.Join(output.Sync(), output.Close())
	if copyErr != nil || closeErr != nil {
		return errors.Join(copyErr, closeErr)
	}
	if n != expected.Size || hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)) != expected.SHA256 {
		return errors.New("private disk copy differs from pristine artifact")
	}
	return nil
}

func lifecycle(ctx context.Context, host platform, m manifest, id identity, executable, bios, artifactDir, evidenceDir, workDir string, log *events) (resultErr error) {
	if err := qemuPreflight(ctx, host, executable, bios, evidenceDir, log); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	disk := filepath.Join(workDir, "volume.ext4")
	if err := copyDisk(filepath.Join(artifactDir, filepath.FromSlash(m.Artifacts["data"].Path)), disk, m.Artifacts["data"]); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := log.record("prepare", "private-disk", map[string]any{"path": disk, "size": m.DiskBytes, "pristine_sha256": m.Artifacts["data"].SHA256}); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	bootCtx, cancelBoot := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 120*time.Second)
	defer cancelBoot()
	var control *controlSocket
	var guest *guestChannel
	var process child
	var successDeadline time.Time
	defer func() {
		deadline := time.Now().Add(10 * time.Second)
		if resultErr == nil && !successDeadline.IsZero() {
			deadline = successDeadline
		}
		forced, cleanupErr := finishGuest(process, control, guest, deadline)
		resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, cleanupErr)
		if process != nil {
			resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, log.record("hygiene", "owned-job", map[string]any{"pid": process.PID(), "forced": forced, "error": errorText(cleanupErr)}))
		}
	}()
	listener, err := host.ListenControl(bootCtx)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("bind owned control endpoint: %w", err)
	}
	control = newControlSocket(listener)
	controlNumber, err := controlPort(listener.Addr())
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := bootCtx.Err(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	forward, err := net.Listen("tcp4", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	port, portErr := controlPort(forward.Addr())
	if err := errors.Join(portErr, forward.Close()); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if port == controlNumber {
		return errors.New("HTTP and control ports collided")
	}
	guest, err = newGuestChannel(id, evidenceDir)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := bootCtx.Err(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	artifactPath := func(name string) string {
		return filepath.Join(artifactDir, filepath.FromSlash(m.Artifacts[name].Path))
	}
	args := qemuArguments(m, id, artifactPath("kernel"), artifactPath("initramfs"), disk, bios, port, controlNumber)
	process, err = host.Start(executable, args, workDir)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	guest.startDiagnostics(process)
	if err := bootCtx.Err(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := log.record("boot", "qemu-started", map[string]any{"pid": process.PID(), "port": port, "control_port": controlNumber, "accel": "tcg", "machine": m.QEMU.Machine}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	conn, proof, err := control.accept(bootCtx, process, guest.fault)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := log.record("boot", "control-peer-verified", proof); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := bootCtx.Err(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	guest.startSerial(conn)
	_, err = guest.receive(bootCtx, 0, "boot-ready", "boot")
	cancelBoot()
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("guest boot: %w", err)
	}

	command := func(sequence uint64, op string) error {
		callCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 30*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		value, err := guest.command(callCtx, sequence, op)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("guest %s: %w", op, err)
		}
		return log.record(op, "guest-acknowledgement", value)
	}
	if err := command(1, "start"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	endpoint := "http://127.0.0.1:" + strconv.Itoa(port)
	created, err := runProbe(ctx, host, guest, artifactPath("probe_windows_arm64"), evidenceDir, endpoint, m.Volume, "readiness-create", 1)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("readiness-create: %w", err)
	}
	if err := log.record("readiness-create", "probe", created); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := command(2, "stop-authority"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := command(3, "start"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	reopened, err := runProbe(ctx, host, guest, artifactPath("probe_windows_arm64"), evidenceDir, endpoint, m.Volume, "readiness-reopen", 2)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("readiness-reopen: %w", err)
	}
	if reopened.ObjectID != created.ObjectID || reopened.AuthorityEpoch == created.AuthorityEpoch {
		return errors.New("reopen did not preserve object identity across a new authority epoch")
	}
	if err := log.record("readiness-reopen", "probe", reopened); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	shutdownCtx, cancelShutdown := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 30*time.Second)
	defer cancelShutdown()
	successDeadline, _ = shutdownCtx.Deadline()
	acknowledged, err := guest.command(shutdownCtx, 4, "shutdown")
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("guest shutdown: %w", err)
	}
	if err := log.record("shutdown", "guest-acknowledgement", acknowledged); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	select {
	case <-process.Done():
		if err := process.Result(); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	case err := <-guest.fault:
		return err
	case <-shutdownCtx.Done():
		return fmt.Errorf("QEMU poweroff: %w", shutdownCtx.Err())
	}
	if err := joinReaders(shutdownCtx, guest.readers); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	select {
	case err := <-guest.fault:
		return err
	default:
	}
	select {
	case value := <-guest.responses:
		return fmt.Errorf("unexpected final guest response: %s", value.Op)
	default:
	}
	return log.record("shutdown", "confirmed", map[string]any{"authority_exit": 0, "qemu_exit": 0, "ext4_unmounted": true})
}

func errorText(err error) string {
	if err == nil {
		return ""
	}
	return err.Error()
}

func run(ctx context.Context, o options) (resultErr error) {
	if o.RequireNative {
		return errors.New("current adapter native acceptance is unavailable; fixture readiness cannot satisfy it")
	}
	if !hex40.MatchString(o.SourceSHA) || !hex40.MatchString(o.SourceTreeSHA) || !runIDPattern.MatchString(o.RunID) {
		return errors.New("invalid checkout SHA, tree SHA, or run ID")
	}
	for _, path := range []string{o.Repo, o.ArtifactDir, o.PackageDir} {
		if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
			return errors.New("repository, artifact, and package paths must be absolute")
		}
		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if !info.IsDir() || info.Mode()&(os.ModeSymlink|os.ModeIrregular) != 0 {
			return fmt.Errorf("directory is a reparse point or not a directory: %s", path)
		}
	}
	var m manifest
	if err := readJSON(filepath.Join(o.ArtifactDir, "manifest.json"), &m); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := validateManifest(m, o); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	self, err := os.Executable()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	actual, _, err := fileHash(self)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if actual != m.Artifacts["controller_windows_arm64"].SHA256 {
		return errors.New("running controller differs from source-bound artifact")
	}
	var pkg packageManifest
	if err := readJSON(filepath.Join(o.PackageDir, "package-manifest.json"), &pkg); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if pkg.Format != 1 || pkg.ArchiveSHA512 != qemuSHA512 || pkg.SevenZipVersion == "" {
		return errors.New("QEMU package provenance mismatch")
	}
	if err := verifyFiles(o.PackageDir, pkg.Files); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := filepath.WalkDir(o.PackageDir, func(path string, entry os.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
		if walkErr != nil {
			return walkErr
		}
		if path == o.PackageDir {
			return nil
		}
		if entry.Type()&(os.ModeSymlink|os.ModeIrregular) != 0 {
			return fmt.Errorf("QEMU package contains reparse path: %s", path)
		}
		if entry.IsDir() {
			return nil
		}
		relative, err := filepath.Rel(o.PackageDir, path)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		relative = filepath.ToSlash(relative)
		if relative != "package-manifest.json" {
			if _, ok := pkg.Files[relative]; !ok {
				return fmt.Errorf("unmanifested QEMU file: %s", relative)
			}
		}
		return nil
	}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	executable, err := safePath(o.PackageDir, pkg.Executable)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	bios, err := safePath(o.PackageDir, pkg.DataDir)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"bios-256k.bin", "kvmvapic.bin", "linuxboot_dma.bin"} {
		path, err := safePath(bios, name)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("QEMU boot data: %w", err)
		}
		if _, _, err = fileHash(path); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	host, err := nativeHostPlatform(executable,
		filepath.Join(o.ArtifactDir, filepath.FromSlash(m.Artifacts["probe_windows_arm64"].Path)),
		filepath.Join(o.ArtifactDir, filepath.FromSlash(m.Artifacts["controller_windows_arm64"].Path)))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	facts, err := host.Preflight()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	nonceBytes := make([]byte, 32)
	if _, err := rand.Read(nonceBytes); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	id := identity{o.RunID, m.SourceSHA, hex.EncodeToString(nonceBytes)}
	root := filepath.Join(o.Repo, ".tmp", "native-current-authority-fixture", "windows-runs")
	if err := makeOwnedDirectories(o.Repo, ".tmp/native-current-authority-fixture/windows-runs"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err := safePath(o.Repo, ".tmp/native-current-authority-fixture/windows-runs"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	directory := filepath.Join(root, o.RunID)
	if err := createPrivateDirectory(directory); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("private run directory must be new: %w", err)
	}
	evidenceDir, workDir := filepath.Join(directory, "evidence"), filepath.Join(directory, "work")
	if err := createPrivateDirectory(evidenceDir); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := createPrivateDirectory(workDir); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	eventFile, err := privateOutput(filepath.Join(evidenceDir, "events.jsonl"))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer eventFile.Close()
	log := &events{identity: id, output: &cappedWriter{writer: eventFile, remaining: streamLimit}}
	defer func() {
		var removeErr error
		if errors.Is(resultErr, errOwnedCleanup) {
			removeErr = errors.New("private disk retained because owned process termination is unconfirmed")
		} else {
			removeErr = os.RemoveAll(workDir)
		}
		resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, removeErr)
		pristineHash, pristineSize, pristineErr := fileHash(filepath.Join(o.ArtifactDir, filepath.FromSlash(m.Artifacts["data"].Path)))
		if pristineErr == nil && (pristineHash != m.Artifacts["data"].SHA256 || pristineSize != m.DiskBytes) {
			pristineErr = errors.New("pristine artifact changed during run")
		}
		resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, pristineErr)
		status := "failed"
		if resultErr == nil {
			status = "passed"
		}
		receipt := map[string]any{"run_id": id.RunID, "source_sha": id.SourceSHA, "fixture_nonce": id.Nonce, "fixture_readiness": status, "native_acceptance": "not-run", "cause": errorText(resultErr), "private_disk_removed": removeErr == nil, "pristine_unchanged": pristineErr == nil}
		resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, log.record("result", "fixture-readiness", receipt))
		data, err := json.MarshalIndent(receipt, "", "  ")
		if err == nil {
			err = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(evidenceDir, "receipt.json"), append(data, '\n'), 0600)
		}
		resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, err, eventFile.Sync())
	}()
	if err := log.record("preflight", "host", facts); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := log.record("provenance", "verified", map[string]any{"source_tree_sha": m.SourceTreeSHA, "artifacts": m.Artifacts, "qemu": pkg, "image_version": os.Getenv("ImageVersion")}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return lifecycle(ctx, host, m, id, executable, bios, o.ArtifactDir, evidenceDir, workDir, log)
}

func nativeHostPlatform(qemu, probe, controller string) (platform, error) {
	for _, executable := range []struct{ name, path string }{
		{"QEMU", qemu}, {"probe", probe}, {"controller", controller},
	} {
		if err := requireMachine(executable.path, pe.IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_ARM64); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s host executable: %w", executable.name, err)
		}
	}
	return newPlatform()
}

func requireMachine(path string, expected uint16) error {
	file, err := pe.Open(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer file.Close()
	if file.Machine != expected {
		return fmt.Errorf("PE machine mismatch for %s: got 0x%x, want 0x%x", path, file.Machine, expected)
	}
	return nil
}

func extractArchive(ctx context.Context, archive, extractor, directory string) error {
	for _, path := range []string{archive, extractor, directory} {
		if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
			return errors.New("extraction paths must be absolute")
		}
	}
	file, err := os.Open(archive)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	hash := sha512.New()
	_, hashErr := io.Copy(hash, file)
	if err := errors.Join(hashErr, file.Close()); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)) != qemuSHA512 {
		return errors.New("QEMU extraction archive SHA512 mismatch")
	}
	host, err := newPlatform()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err := host.Preflight(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := validatePrivateDirectory(directory); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	output := filepath.Join(directory, "extracted")
	if err := createPrivateDirectory(output); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	extractCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 120*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	_, err = runTool(extractCtx, host, extractor, []string{"x", "-y", "-bd", "-o" + output, archive}, directory, "seven-zip")
	return err
}

func main() {
	var o options
	var archive, extractor, extractDir, prepareDir string
	flag.StringVar(&prepareDir, "prepare-directory", "", "atomically create a private bootstrap directory")
	flag.StringVar(&archive, "extract-archive", "", "verified pinned NSIS archive to extract only")
	flag.StringVar(&extractor, "extractor", "", "installed 7-Zip executable")
	flag.StringVar(&extractDir, "extract-dir", "", "owned bootstrap directory")
	flag.StringVar(&o.Repo, "repo-root", "", "absolute clean checkout path")
	flag.StringVar(&o.ArtifactDir, "artifact-dir", "", "absolute source-bound Linux artifact directory")
	flag.StringVar(&o.PackageDir, "package-dir", "", "absolute verified QEMU extraction directory")
	flag.StringVar(&o.SourceSHA, "source-sha", "", "expected clean checkout commit")
	flag.StringVar(&o.SourceTreeSHA, "source-tree-sha", "", "expected clean checkout tree")
	flag.StringVar(&o.RunID, "run-id", "", "unique run directory name")
	flag.BoolVar(&o.RequireNative, "require-native-acceptance", false, "fail unless current adapter native acceptance is available")
	flag.Parse()
	if flag.NArg() != 0 {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "unexpected positional arguments")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	ctx, cancel := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), os.Interrupt)
	defer cancel()
	if prepareDir != "" {
		relative, err := filepath.Rel(o.Repo, prepareDir)
		if err != nil || !filepath.IsAbs(o.Repo) || !filepath.IsAbs(prepareDir) || !strings.HasPrefix(filepath.ToSlash(relative), ".tmp/native-current-authority-fixture/bootstrap-") || strings.Contains(filepath.Base(prepareDir), ":") {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "bootstrap directory must be under the task repository .tmp")
			os.Exit(2)
		}
		if err := createPrivateDirectory(prepareDir); err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
			os.Exit(1)
		}
		return
	}
	if archive != "" {
		if err := extractArchive(ctx, archive, extractor, extractDir); err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
			os.Exit(1)
		}
		fmt.Println("Pinned QEMU archive extracted; no fixture was started.")
		return
	}
	if extractor != "" || extractDir != "" {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "extraction requires an archive")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	if err := run(ctx, o); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println("Fixture readiness passed; native acceptance was not run.")
}
